palette_rationale: Retain the reviewed pale face and body, green ear marks and collar, dark source eyes, pink mouth and black outline from the approved Idle palette.
reference: Own DSTS chr701 Terriermon mesh and native clips; PMDO registry supplies action names and event fields.
ground_policy_note: Grounded 20px Idle with a fixed row-47 shadow. Walk follows feet; source-native lift and recoil are preserved. Never trim Idle or Physical Attack.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Own stepping and alternating long-ear flap; loop endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Native forward leap and ear-led strike; Physical Attack is never trimmed.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Native ear-lift and forward release; no projectile or glow.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Source crouch/rest; source eyes retained without invented eyelids.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Own backward recoil and asymmetric ear swing.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Own ear-and-body sweep; bs02 was rejected because its source motion exits fixed framing.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two visual contacts of the native ear-led strike; one engine HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Distinct source-native hop and ear lift; no artificial vertical offset.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Bounded first second of the native ear-raise Charge with reverse-sampled recovery; later source somersault is excluded and no effect is added.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Own turning clip with whole-view yaw; endpoint excluded.
